experimentalEncoder.embeddingSource: learned additive feature vectors trained from positive and hard-negative phrase pairs
experimentalEncoder.quantization: sign bit quantization to binary code

caution: experimentalPatchCount still comes from the current patch packer. The learned encoder only replaces the continuous embedding source before normalize -> sign, and it remains a prototype until the frozen holdouts pass.

entries.text: Start before confidence arrives, then keep the promise you made to yourself when the work becomes boring.
A strong routine turns difficult goals into ordinary tasks, and ordinary tasks are what actually finish big projects.
The day improves when the first hour belongs to deliberate effort instead of distraction.
Consistency matters more than bursts of intensity because systems survive moods.
Clear language removes excuses; when the description sharpens, the decision usually becomes obvious.
Facts remain useful when pride does not, so write the numbers down before memory edits the story.
Honest diagnosis feels slow at first, but it prevents expensive confusion later.
A direct sentence can expose a weak plan faster than a week of polite agreement.
Wait long enough to see the second-order effect, then act with less drama and more accuracy.
A repair made in haste often returns as a larger repair, so deliberate attention can be the faster path.
Time does not solve every problem, but it reveals which problems deserve permanent changes.
Deliberate pacing keeps the system stable when pressure invites reckless shortcuts.
Courage is not loud; it is the quiet decision to proceed after the risk becomes real.
The first public attempt is always uncomfortable, but hiding the work teaches nothing.
Hard conversations get cheaper when they happen early and get expensive when they wait.
Move toward the decision that protects the mission, even if it costs comfort.
Good craft is measured by how well the thing holds up under repeated use, not by how impressive the demo looked.
Every clean revision removes a future error, which is why careful design compounds.
The right tool saves time, but clear judgment decides when the tool should be ignored.
Strong systems are built from small corrections that stay in place under load.
